description: Static layout, data or appearance for this part of the chart.

signals.name: colorSurface
signals.description: Colour: white, the colour of the card each chart sits on. This is only a backup; the real colour comes from --color-surface in css/style.css.

signals.name: colorPetDogs
signals.description: Colour: the colour for dogs (amber). This is only a backup; the real colour comes from --color-pet-dogs in css/style.css.

signals.name: fontHeading
signals.description: Font: the fancy title font (DM Serif Display). This is only a backup; the real font comes from --font-heading in css/style.css.

signals.name: fontBody
signals.description: Font: the plain font for all other text (Fira Sans). This is only a backup; the real font comes from --font-body in css/style.css.

signals.name: colorPetDogsLight
signals.description: Colour: the palest shade of the colour for dogs (amber). This is only a backup; the real colour comes from --color-pet-dogs-light in css/style.css.

signals.name: colorPetDogsDark
signals.description: Colour: the darkest shade of the colour for dogs (amber). This is only a backup; the real colour comes from --color-pet-dogs-dark in css/style.css.

signals.name: width
signals.description: Measured by the loader; small-screen charts keep a compact minimum width.

signals.name: narrow
signals.description: Short labels for a compact chart; no data are removed.

signals.name: plotHeight
signals.description: Identical viewport height to the symbol map beside it, so places line up.

signals.name: height
signals.description: Viewport plus a small fixed legend area.

signals.name: breaks
signals.description: The boundaries between the five dog-rate classes, per 1,000 residents.

signals.name: cameraLon
signals.description: Longitude at the centre of the fixed map view.

signals.name: cameraLat
signals.description: Latitude at the centre of the fixed map view.

signals.name: cameraSpan
signals.description: Vertical extent of the fixed view over the settled south.

signals.name: colorPetDogsMidLight
signals.description: Second dog-rate class; the theme reads --color-pet-dogs-mid-light.

signals.name: colorPetDogsMidDark
signals.description: Fourth dog-rate class; the theme reads --color-pet-dogs-mid-dark.

data.name: rates
data.description: Dog totals, residents and dog rates for the 68 councils; the maps show the settled south.

transform.description: Show dogs; cats remain in the source table and the density scatterplot.
Turn the council code into text, so it matches the code in the shapes file.

data.name: councils
data.description: Council shapes, each with the chosen species' numbers attached.

transform.description: Turn each shape's council code into text, so it matches the numbers file.
Tidy the council name by removing " (SA)" from the end.
Match each shape to its numbers by council code and copy across the animals recorded, the rate per 1,000 residents and residents.
Mark whether each council is one of the 18 in Greater Adelaide (listed by name).
transform.expr: indexof(['Adelaide', 'Burnside', 'Campbelltown (SA)', 'Charles Sturt', 'Gawler', 'Holdfast Bay', 'Marion', 'Mitcham', 'Norwood Payneham and St Peters', 'Onkaparinga', 'Playford', 'Port Adelaide Enfield', 'Prospect', 'Salisbury', 'Tea Tree Gully', 'Unley', 'Walkerville', 'West Torrens'], datum.properties.lga_name_2025) >= 0

transform.description: collect transform derives fields for points; field/as name the input/output columns.

data.name: mappedCouncils
data.description: Draw the 68 councils with an animal record; other geometries are outside dataset coverage.

transform.description: Exclude unincorporated and non-municipal geometries rather than imply an observed zero.

marks.description: Static layout, data or appearance for this part of the chart.

marks.name: councilAreas
marks.description: Static layout, data or appearance for this part of the chart.

tooltip.signal: {'Council': datum.name, 'Dogs recorded at home': format(datum.animals, ',.0f'), 'Residents': format(datum.residents, ',.0f'), 'Dogs per 1,000 residents': format(datum.rate, '.1f')}

text.signal: datum.value < breaks[0] ? 'Under ' + breaks[0] : datum.value < breaks[1] ? breaks[0] + '–' + (breaks[1] - 1) : datum.value < breaks[2] ? breaks[1] + '–' + (breaks[2] - 1) : datum.value < breaks[3] ? breaks[2] + '–' + (breaks[3] - 1) : breaks[3] + ' or more'

usermeta.camera: Conic equal-area; same projection, centre, span and viewport height as the dot map.

scales.rateColour: Five fixed dog-rate classes with boundaries at 100, 200, 300 and 400 dogs per 1,000 residents. Colours come from the dog ramp in the stylesheet.

usermeta.codeGuide: Signals set the responsive layout and theme. Data transforms derive values; scales map them to positions and colours; marks draw the chart.

projections.map: conicEqualArea projection; camera or fit parameters control the visible geography.
